visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short brown hair stands on a grey tiled terrace before a turquoise infinity pool and a vast ocean horizon. She wears a white lace-patterned cardigan over black swimwear, her eyes closed in a serene pose with hands clasped over her heart. (2) The scene shifts to an indoor restaurant where she uses wooden chopsticks to consume a bowl of beef noodles. (3) She is seen in a medical clinic room sitting on a blue examination bed, wearing a pink face mask and looking tired. (4) In a bright airport terminal, she poses excitedly with two older adults, making a fist and smiling. (5) A rapid montage follows showing her waving in front of the Merlion statue, posing with Marina Bay Sands in the background, and walking through Gardens by the Bay. (6) At night in Fukuoka, she holds a paper shopping bag and makes a peace sign on a busy street. (7) She is shown grilling meat on a charcoal stove and walking across a sunny wooden terrace with ocean views in Atami. (8) At night on a crowded beach, she watches large golden fireworks burst in the sky. (9) Further travel clips show her at the Petronas Twin Towers at night, at the colorful Batu Caves, and eating local food in Nagoya. (10) She enters a hotel room with multiple shopping bags, swims in an urban pool in Bangkok, and receives a massage. (11) In Jeju, she drives a go-kart and writes 'Jeju' in the sand on a beach at sunset. (12) Finally, she stands in a festive Christmas market in Hokkaido at night with a large illuminated tower in the background.
